The counters are not permanently stuck (they advanced 2,292,477 across the session) but the update mechanism was NOT determined and no Q14 claim depends on it (q14-statdump-unusable.txt). Q14's physical-read evidence uses /proc/<pid>/io sampled across every engine PID plus PostgreSQL's pg_statio / EXPLAIN BUFFERS counters. The /proc/io section of Q14-cubrid-buffer-io-diag.json is NOT affected and IS cited.
